newsitem.title: UK: Dewhirst gains as BZW raises to "buy".
newsitem.headline: Dewhirst gains as BZW raises to "buy".

text.p: Shares in Dewhirst Group Plc, a supplier of clothing to top retail group Marks & Spencer Plc, rose on Wednesday as BZW upgraded the stock after Tuesday's better-than-expected results.
Dewhirst shares were up 8p at 184-1/2 by 1254 GMT, its highest since early last December, in volume of 728,378 shares.

BZW raised the stock to "buy" and added two percent to its pre-tax profit estimates for the company, highlighting the company's success in widening trading margins to 8.2 percent from 7.8 percent, market sources said.
With Tuesday's results showing 18 percent sales growth, sources said BZW argued that there was evidence that Dewhirst's agressive value and innovation stategy were still boosting sales.
Dewhirst posted an 18 percent rise in yearly pre-tax profit to 26.4 million stg and upped its dividend 20.1 percent to 4.35p per shares
Analysts at BZW were not immediately available for comment.
